messages.termLoad.TERM_CAPACITY_AVAILABLE: Within normal capacity: {courseUnits} of {normalCourseUnits} modeled units.
messages.termLoad.ECONOMICS_LOAD_ABOVE_PREFERENCE: Within normal capacity: {courseUnits} of {normalCourseUnits} modeled units. The Economics load is above the advising preference.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_APPROVED: Advisor-approved overload: {courseUnits} modeled units; the approved ceiling is {conditionalMaximumCourseUnits}. Approval and absence of academic probation were recorded for this term.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: More information needed: {courseUnits} modeled units exceed the normal {normalCourseUnits}. Record existing advisor approval and confirmation that you are not on academic probation before using additional capacity; the conditional ceiling is {conditionalMaximumCourseUnits}.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_APPROVAL_DENIED: An overload is blocked because advisor approval was not granted. This term models {courseUnits} units, above the normal {normalCourseUnits}.
messages.termLoad.pending: More information needed: the normal-load search found no complete plan. Advisor overload approval and absence of academic probation have not been established for {terms}. No additional capacity has been granted; the search does not establish impossibility under an approved overload.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED_ON_AC: An overload is not permitted while you are on academic probation. This move models {courseUnits} units, above the normal {normalCourseUnits}.
messages.termLoad.TERM_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: This move models {courseUnits} units and exceeds the published term limit ({conditionalMaximumCourseUnits} units, with any applicable Economics course limit). Additional tuition does not authorize this move.
messages.tuition.threshold.exceeded: The modeled {period} load is {modeledUnits} units, above the published {threshold}-unit tuition threshold. Additional tuition applies to actual enrollment above that threshold; this major plan does not establish your complete enrollment or a charge. Paying additional tuition does not increase the term limit.
messages.tuition.threshold.possible: Additional tuition applies above {threshold} registered units across {period}. This plan models {modeledUnits} units and does not establish your complete enrollment or a charge. Paying additional tuition does not increase the term limit.
messages.infeasibility.electives.spring: You still need {remainingElectives} distinct Economics electives. After finance is allocated, no remaining eligible elective is offered in {winterTerm}. The {springTerm} options are {springOptions}. Each is {courseUnits} unit, so two exceed both the normal {normalCourseUnits}-unit load and the advisor-approved {conditionalMaximumCourseUnits}-unit ceiling.
messages.infeasibility.electives.conflict: {leftCourse} and {rightCourse} also meet at the same time.
messages.infeasibility.finance.forced: {financeCourse} must fill finance for this graduation target, so it cannot also count as an elective.
messages.infeasibility.capstone.seniorStanding: ECO 461 requires senior standing and is offered only in Winter. With this graduation year you will not have senior standing in any Winter term before you graduate. Choose a later graduation year or talk with your advisor.
messages.electivePlanning.limit: At most one Economics elective may be planned in an unpublished Fall, Winter or May term. Extra electives require matching verified sections and all academic checks.
messages.electivePlanning.named: This named future course needs a matching verified offering. Use an eligible elective slot or confirm the finance requirement with your advisor.
messages.allocation.financePetition: You may petition to count BUSN 323 as an Economics elective. This planner does not apply that credit; discuss the petition with your advisor.
